name: button
title: Button
description: The action a player takes that is not a choice: start, continue, play again, claim, share. Primary and secondary, default and large. Pressable controls move rather than fade, so the offset base collapses and the face lands where the base was. Disabled goes flat because it is never coming back; locked keeps its shape and shows a padlock because it is available later, and a player can tell those apart at a glance. Reads tokens only, so a theme change reaches it. Reports the press to the host; it does not start a round, claim a reward or share a result itself, and it does not fetch or settle anything. Use `choice` when the player is answering a question from presented options, and `selector` when they are picking one value from a set, such as a difficulty or a predicted goal total.
docs: Use variant="primary" for the one action on the surface and "secondary" for everything beside it. Use size="large" for the hero action a player is meant to reach for. Pass `locked` when the action opens later and `disabled` when it never will. Locked refuses the click, including the one Enter and Space synthesise, but stays focusable so a screen reader can still describe it; disabled uses the native attribute and leaves the tab order.
